Bring a session's branch into the git repository you are in

## Synopsis

Fetches the branch that the session's folder has checked out, over your SSH connection, into a branch
of the repository in the current folder: the same name, or --into. It changes neither working tree.

```text
simstim pull <host>/<session> [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  simstim pull my-vps/auth-fix
  simstim pull my-vps/auth-fix --into review/auth-fix
```

## Options

```text
      --force         move the local branch even when the fetch is not a fast-forward
  -h, --help          help for pull
      --into string   the local branch to fetch into (default: the session's branch name)
```
